headline: Mural raises $15 million Series A led by Tether to scale agentic finance
body: Financial infrastructure company Mural said it has raised $15 million in a Series A round led by Tether, the issuer of USDT. The round will support its global expansion and its regulatory and payments infrastructure for agentic finance.
note: Tether led the round, and its CEO, Paolo Ardoino, says that as agents start moving money, the link to banks, payment networks and compliance systems becomes essential.

figure.label: Series A round, led by Tether

evidence.text: Financial infrastructure company Mural said it has raised $15 million in new funding.

The Series A financing round will support the firm’s global expansion and investments in the regulatory and payments infrastructure needed to scale agentic finance, Mural said in a Tuesday (Oct. 20) news release .
The funding round was led by Tether , issuer of USDT, the world’s largest stablecoin.
“As agents start moving money, that connection to the banks, payment networks and compliance systems the world still runs on becomes essential, and Mural is already doing it at scale,” Ardoino said.
